The Nasdaq Composite ( ^IXIC +0.81% ) gained 1.05% to 27,477, while the S&P 500 ( ^GSPC +0.71% ) rose 0.66% to 7,774 and the Dow Jones Industrial Average ( ^DJI +0.57% ) added 0.18% to 51,268 as tech optimism overshadowed elevated Treasury yields.
Gold prices gained 0.10% to $4,138.68, and the 10-Year Treasury yield rose 0.03% to 5.31%. Almost every sector gained, with industrials and communication stocks surging, while real estate slipped slightly.
Vaxcyte shares soared over 30% on positive late-stage vaccine success, while Genmab gained almost 11% after announcing positive lymphoma drug data…
